headlines.title: Trump says he’s banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said Friday that he had banned CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House over what he called their “constant ‘reporting’ FAKE NEWS.”

headlines.title: Breaking down the proposals lawmakers are considering to regulate AI
headlines.description: Congress is facing growing calls to put new safeguards on advanced AI. NBC News’ Sahil Kapur breaks down four key proposals from lawmakers and what they could mean for the future of artificial intelligence.

headlines.title: Russia holds first parliamentary election since war in Ukraine began
headlines.description: Russia is holding the country's first parliamentary elections since the war in Ukraine began. NBC News' Matt Bodner has details on the elections and what critics of Russian President Vladimir Putin had to say about the process.

headlines.title: Singer-songwriter and Broadway composer Duncan Sheik dies at 56
headlines.description: Singer-songwriter and Broadway composer Duncan Sheik has died, according to a post on his Instagram account.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy’s Husband and Holdout Juror Break Their Silence
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy’s former husband, and his new wife, are speaking out for the first time since the mistrial and addressing the emotional case and opening up about their grief. It comes as the lone holdout in the case is offering his version of events inside the jury room and the reasons, he says, he fought for a guilty verdict. NBC's Emilie Ikeda reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Kim Kardashian’s new health scare: What is esophagitis?
headlines.description: Kim Kardashian revealed in the trailer for Season 8 of “The Kardashians” that she’s facing a new health condition.

headlines.title: Texas college quarterback apologizes for comments about violent AI video
headlines.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning apologized for referencing an AI video showing his coach slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe. “In my press conference yesterday, I made an insensitive comment about an AI video. There is nothing funny about it,” Manning wrote.

headlines.title: The first mRNA flu shot is now available. Here’s who can get it.
headlines.description: People looking to get their annual flu shot this fall may find a new option alongside the usual vaccines: an mRNA flu shot. Not everyone is eligible, however.

headlines.title: Police investigating aircraft collision in New York
headlines.description: Two aircrafts crashed midair in Edinburg, New York, on Friday, prompting a heavy law enforcement response, according to Broadcastify from the Saratoga County Fire and EMS.

headlines.title: Ponzi schemer who defrauded Travis Kelce tried to marry U.S. citizen to avoid deportation, prosecutors say
headlines.description: The undocumented Indian immigrant behind a multi-million dollar Ponzi scheme tried to marry an American citizen before he was sentenced to 11 years in prison, court records show.

headlines.title: California Gov. Gavin Newsom inks AI oversight executive order to improve safety ‘before it’s too late’
headlines.description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom on Friday signed an executive order intended to increase oversight of and safety measures regarding artifical intelligence “before it’s too late.”
